1. (S) SITUATION:
A detached Soviet submarine wolf pack has localized the USS Nimitz carrier battle group south of Iceland. The carrier and its escorts are operating in an area where the surface task force cannot close without exposing the submarines to air attack.
2. (S) MISSION: 2.1 Strike and disable the USS Nimitz. 2.2 At least one submarine must survive.
3. (S) EXECUTION: 3.1 Approach covertly and preserve the submarine force's advantage in concealment. 3.2 Coordinate the attack against the carrier and exploit any gaps in the escort screen. 3.3 Expend weapons decisively, then break contact before the enemy can organize a sustained counterattack. 3.4 Withdraw surviving submarines from the carrier group's immediate operating area.
4. (S) ENEMY SITUATION: 4.1 USS Nimitz carrier battle group. 4.2 Carrier escorts and organic anti-submarine aircraft are expected.
5. (S) FRIENDLY SITUATION: 5.1 A detached Soviet submarine wolf pack is assigned to the strike. 5.2 The surface task force remains outside the immediate engagement area and will not provide direct support.
6. (S) INTEL ASSESSMENT: 6.1 The carrier group is aware that Soviet submarines are operating in the North Atlantic but has not fixed the attack force's position. 6.2 The first salvo must achieve decisive damage. Survival of the submarine force is essential to follow-on operations.
